title: Stop seeding at optional ratio or time limits without deleting content
description:
Fork research: parallel GPT-6 Astra source reviews, 2026-10-25. Current application baseline: 3ae404b.

## Purpose and evidence

Simple Torrent has ratio/time seeding policies, while this app offers EnableSeeding only. Add explicit resource budgets so users can share content without an indefinite upload commitment. Do not copy automatic torrent/cache removal or implicit exceptions for manual starts.

## Acceptance criteria

- Provide optional validated ratio and elapsed-active-seeding-time thresholds with explicit disabled values; document whether either threshold stops sharing and how selected-file completion/existing data are counted.
- Project finite upload accounting and a clear stopped-by-policy reason. Pause transfers at the limit while retaining downloaded files, session metadata and selections; provide a deliberate manual resume/override.
- Persist accounting/time budgets so restart does not silently reset limits. User-paused time must not accrue as seeding time; handle zero denominators safely and preserve EnableUpload/EnableSeeding controls.
- Integrate with queue advancement exactly once. Do not auto-delete files, source .torrents or session history.
- Test threshold boundaries, selected-file completion, existing verified data, pause/resume, restart and override with a controlled clock and local peers.

## Sources

- https://github.com/boypt/simple-torrent/blob/6f4942933b71106bae00b4f4c94438e3b315fca2/engine/engine.go#L315-L339
- https://github.com/boypt/simple-torrent/blob/6f4942933b71106bae00b4f4c94438e3b315fca2/engine/torrent.go#L97-L127
- https://github.com/jpillora/cloud-torrent/blob/3ae404b282d7678f90e16b0bf84a52d872fc73d9/engine/config.go

## Scope

Implement within the existing Go engine, typed API, generated frontend models and authenticated handler chain. Use isolated legal fixtures; never test against live downloads. This is a new backlog item, not a claim that the proposed behavior already exists.

## Prerequisites

#76, #78.
